environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs inside a pivot_root(2)-isolated mount namespace with a minimal rootfs (busybox-based, 12MB). The process is further confined via a seccomp-bpf profile (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on connect(2) for any sockaddr_in where sin_port != htons(443) AND sin_addr is not in the 10.200.0.0/24 CIDR). The /proc/self/root contains only /usr/bin/terraform-provider-customapi, /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, libc, and libpthread. A network namespace with a veth pair routes only to a TLS-terminating Envoy sidecar (1.28) at 10.200.0.1:443 which enforces HTTP/2 upstream connections exclusively (no HTTP/1.1 passthrough) and rejects any frame with both content-length and transfer-encoding headers present (via Envoy's internal HTTP/1.1-to-H2 codec validation, envoy.reloadable_features.sanitize_te set to true). The Envoy access log filter `%REQ(TRANSFER-ENCODING)%` triggers connection termination if populated alongside content-length.
